description: Georgia CDL delta. Air brakes, cargo, and hours stay in core_cdl.json.

questions.q: The minimum age to drive a commercial vehicle from Georgia into another state is
questions.explanation: Interstate commerce requires the driver to be at least 21. That federal age applies to a driver leaving this state.

questions.q: You live in Georgia and drive a CMV. Who issues the CDL?
options: The state that titled the truck
The state where the load started
questions.explanation: A CDL is issued by your state of domicile, the state where you live.

questions.q: A driver who is 19 holds a Georgia CDL. Where may they drive a commercial vehicle?
options: In Georgia and its neighboring states
Only with a CDL holder 21 or older aboard
questions.explanation: Georgia issues CDLs at 18, but federal rules (49 CFR 391.11) require drivers in interstate commerce to be at least 21. A driver under 21 may drive commercial vehicles only within Georgia.

provenance.manual: Georgia Drivers Manual | Department of Driver Services

questions.q: In Georgia, what is the youngest age to drive a commercial vehicle only within the state?
questions.explanation: Georgia allows intrastate commercial driving at 18 years; interstate driving requires 21.
